root.name: Italian Game: Evans Gambit Declined
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Bc5 4. b4 Bb6

overview: Black retreats the bishop to b6 instead of taking on b4, so no material has been given. The main line is 5.a4 a6 6.Nc3 Nf6 7.d3 with a Giuoco-like position where White has gained queenside space; sharper tries are 5.b5 Na5 6.Nxe5. White has the initiative and a pawn on b4, while Black has a solid position.

white_ideas.idea: Play a4, Nc3 and d3 to get space and a safe game
Seek the centre with d4 or sharp tactics around e5 and f7 after b5

black_ideas.idea: Keep the bishop on b6 and develop normally with ...Nf6 and ...d6
Counter in the centre with ...d5 when possible

typical_structures.structure: Italian structure with White pawns on b4, a4, e4, d3 against e5/d6

character.notes: Main lines are calm, with sharper tactical options for White after b5.

soundness.notes: A fully playable line for both sides.

structure.notes: Centre in tension, as in the Giuoco Pianissimo.

approach.notes: A normal branch of the Italian.

sublines_that_differ.name: 5.b5 lines
sublines_that_differ.how: Much sharper, with tactics around f7 and the a5 knight.
